notes.title: Playtest Update with Bug Fixes (and Localizations) ✨
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/83d44ebda784a28633ded970e9869df23ad04c21.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, renovators! [/p][p]We're pleased to share that we've just updated the Hozy playtest with a few bug fixes and new localizations! [/p][p][/p][h2]🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the trash tooltip was getting stuck on Level 1[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with items not disappearing once placed in the Lost & Found Box [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the 'discard' tooltip not disappearing if the feature is not used [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the 'right-click to interact' tooltip not disappearing if the window is not opened [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]📸 Changes to Screenshot Folder [/h2][p][/p][p]We noticed that some of you were having trouble accessing your screenshots using the dedicated screenshot tool in-game. 
To help with this, you'll now find your screenshots saved in a new file location: C:/Users/<UserName>/AppData/Local/CozyGame/Saved[/p][p][/p][h2]🌍 New Localizations [/h2][p][/p][p]We know Hozy has renovators all around the world trying to revitalize and reinvigorate each room, so we've made it easier for everyone to enjoy the game with updated language support. 
Localized text is now available for the following languages: French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Serbian, Russian, Ukrainian, and Polish. [/p][p][/p][p]That's everything we have to share for today! 
Most of these changes and updates were made in direct response to you, our wonderful playtesters, sharing your bug reports and suggestions, so please continue to share your experiences here on Steam, or on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fbsky.app%2Fprofile%2Fhozygame.bsky.social"][u]Bluesky[/u][/url], [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fhozygame"][u]Twitter[/u][/url], [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftiktok.com%2F%40hozygame"][u]TikTok[/u][/url], [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Finstagram.com%2Fhozygame"][u]Instagram[/u][/url], and our official [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FVPDuFdFNRS"][u]Discord[/u][/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support! [/p]

notes.title: Playtest update with a brand new room 👀✨
notes.content:
[p]Hello, renovators! [/p][p]
Thank you so much to those of you who have taken the time to try the Hozy playtest so far, we’ve loved seeing your feedback, screenshots, and videos as you discover the world of Hozy and what makes it so special.  [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="RAEyOaM_CLA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We’re incredibly excited to be able to share with you today that the Hozy playtest has now been updated! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/79XfLQn.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You’ll now be able to renovate an additional brand new room as part of the playtest; once belonging to a [i]slightly eccentric[/i] scientist, it’s a tiny downtown apartment that is going to need a lot of love and care before you can start unpacking the new occupant’s belongings. [/p][p]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/zbVRAWQ.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With limited space, you’ll want to get creative and utilize the shelves and balcony as much as possible to make sure the space really feels like home. Your incoming occupant has some bulky items in her possession, so there’s no denying it [i]will[/i] be a challenge to make sure the tiny apartment fits everything she needs. 
We’re looking forward to seeing how you adapt the space to make it [i]just right[/i] for the new owner! [/p][p]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/wrNRSMz.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To experience the new room, simply update or download the Hozy Playtest in your Steam library - and please do leave feedback if there’s anything you’d like to contribute! [/p][p]
If you’d like to continue to stay updated on Hozy’s development, make sure to wishlist us here on Steam, follow us on [u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/hozygame.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/u], [u][url="https://twitter.com/hozygame"]Twitter[/url][/u], [u][url="https://tiktok.com/@hozygame"]TikTok[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://instagram.com/hozygame"]Instagram[/url][/u], and join our [u][url="https://discord.gg/VPDuFdFNRS"]Discord[/url][/u] to share your experiences in the playtest so far! [/p][p]
We look forward to having more to share with you soon! [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary #1: Meet the Devs! ✨
notes.content:
[p]Welcome, renovators, to our very first Dev Diary! [/p][p]We’ve loved seeing your feedback and suggestions on the Hozy playtest, and greatly appreciate everyone who’s taken the time to play and leave comments - thank you! [/p][p]Today, we wanted to share a little more about the incredible team behind Hozy. [/p][h2]Who are the developers?[/h2][p]Hozy is being developed by Come On Games, with a small but passionate team of 5 developers working on the game; founded as a media studio in 2016, the team had originally worked on apps and websites across a bunch of different industries…and then COVID-19 hit. To keep fresh, the team started working on games as a side project to develop their skills, experimenting with different genres. [/p][h3]Why Hozy?[/h3][p]As the team began to hone their game development skills, Egor, the Creative Director of Come on Games, had been spending his spare time playing cozy, relaxing games as well as some interior design and cleaning titles, and had felt like something was missing; they didn’t feel [i]satisfying[/i] enough - so, he decided to begin experimenting with creating his own! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/75445247ece2c85fdae7da5072b78c16cc6cd7b2.gif"][/img][/p][p]There were a lot of early versions of Hozy, but it was when Egor realised he wanted the game to be satisfying in [i]every [/i]moment - where the process of cleaning, moving objects around, and yes, those micro-interactions we all know and love - was as important as the final results, that Hozy truly found its heart. [/p][p]Hozy is a game focused around joy, interaction, and care for the surrounding environment, made by a team that has, since its early days, focused on building excellent user experiences, whether in their early days of app and web development, or in their games; right now, they’re hard at work utilizing the incredible feedback and suggestions from those of you who have tried the playtest…shall we take a little look at what they’ve been working on?[/p][h3]Updates & Bug Fixes [/h3][p]One of the biggest pieces of feedback we received from you, our wonderful playtesters, was that the window-cleaning squidgee tool was getting stuck on corners and edges when you were trying to clean - not ideal! That’s why, in the latest patch, the tool has been optimized, allowing for smoother cleaning and a more streamlined experience. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/076c477973613f29a5e38f92e3a1e7bbb9fe4d0e.gif"][/img][/p][p]Another thing we noticed in your feedback was that placing carpets around furniture wasn’t as easy as we intended it to be; so, you’ll now find that in the playtest, you can place carpets even under existing furniture to really create the perfect look, without having to rearrange everything! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/289a1e59e9ea117417bc2c2ef32c5ed31c32de7e.gif"][/img][/p][p]Aside from these two major fixes, we’ve also been taking a lot of your suggestions into account; that’s why since the playtest’s launch, more localization options have been added for various languages, and both Mac OS and Steam Deck features have been incorporated for those who were itching to be a part of the playtest on various platforms! 
[/p][p]We hope you’ve enjoyed the first Dev Diary for Hozy, and that we’ve given you a suitable little sneak peek into what you’ll be able to expect from the final game; if you’d like to stay updated, make sure to wishlist us here on Steam, follow us on [u][url="https://twitter.com/hozygame"]Twitter[/url][/u], [u][url="https://tiktok.com/@hozygame"]TikTok[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://instagram.com/hozygame"]Instagram[/url][/u], and join our [u][url="https://discord.gg/VPDuFdFNRS"]Discord[/url][/u] to share your experiences in the playtest so far! [/p][p]We look forward to having more to share with you soon![/p]

notes.title: Playtest Update and macOS version are now live!
notes.content:
[p]UPD. We found an issue which could prevent some of you from installing MacOS version - it's fixed now. You may need to relaunch Steam to proceed to download.

Hello everyone!
[/p][p]We hope you're having a lovely time cleaning and renovating rooms in [b]Hozy[/b]! Seeing your amazing screenshots in [url="https://discord.gg/VPDuFdFNRS"]Discord[/url] and on social media fills us with joy. Your creativity gives us so much energy and inspiration to keep making Hozy even cozier and better.
[/p][p]We’ve been actively reading your feedback, watching your streams and YouTube videos, and already making changes based on the things you’ve pointed out. Thank you so much for that!
[/p][p]And speaking of updates, today we're happy to share what’s new in this small patch for the current playtest:
[/p][h2]🧺 New Feature – Lost & Found Box[/h2][p]Need to temporarily set aside a lamp or table you’re not ready to place? Simply throw it outside the room (don’t worry, it won’t get damaged or disappear). It will be stored in a special Lost & Found box, ready for you to retrieve and use later when inspiration strikes![/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc1ViRFwuVV0vBUrsJjVtBM8TxjPSO3vfHybNh0y293U9-CaYiTD-KkH5kMloRo_SD91EgRpAN3uQvs_X7n20RQVeqkSByY1DJlq67RvqZS_4s8Iow2p_ulOSTY4s7xA3QI_XE66w?key=x-luw7gWhbCGTx9hx3nZbQ"][/img][/p][h2]🍎 Experimental macOS Support[/h2][p]We want [b]Hozy[/b] to be available to as many people as possible, and we’re happy to announce that the game is now playable on macOS! Join the playtest today and let us know what you think.[/p][p]Please note that to run the game on your Mac, you need to have [b]at least macOS 13.0 installed[/b]. This is our experimental build, so the game might have some performance issues.
[/p][h2]🧠 Improved Tooltips and Hints[/h2][p]We’ve added new tooltips to make it easier to learn how to use tools and interact with objects. We aim to help you jump into [b]Hozy[/b] without friction and enjoy the cozy flow from the start.
[/p][h2]🌍 New Languages[/h2][p]Hozy is now available in even more languages so renovators around the world can enjoy the game with ease:[/p][p]French, Russian, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Serbian, Ukrainian, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.[/p][p]  [/p][h2]🔧 Other Improvements and Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Added many new sound effects for object interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various small bugs[/p][/*][*][p]General performance improvements
[/p][/*][/list][p]That’s it for today! [/p][p]Let us know what you think, and keep sharing your rooms, clips, and feedback with us in our [url="https://discord.gg/VPDuFdFNRS"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of Hozy’s journey 💛[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Introducing Hozy ✨ Playtest live! WISHLIST NOW!
notes.content:
Welcome, renovators! 

Allow us to introduce you to Hozy, our cozy renovation and cleaning game where you’ll transform once-chaotic environments into perfect homes. 

[previewyoutube=AbDSwdOZUwk;full][/previewyoutube]
Clean, repair, and decorate your way through neglected properties as you bring a once-thriving neighborhood back to life at your own pace; with each reinvigorated room you unveil, you’ll notice whole districts awaken, showing that a little care can indeed revive whole communities. 

We’re also excited to share that as of [b]right now[/b], you can participate in the first-ever playtest for Hozy here on Steam; simply sign up to join, and you’ll be one of the first to immerse yourself in a glimpse of what Hozy has to offer. 

Yearning to begin? Follow Hozy on [url=https://discord.gg/VPDuFdFNRS]Discord[/url], [url=https://x.com/hozygame]Twitter/X[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@hozygame]TikTok[/url] to join us on our journey, and don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam to be the first to know when we have news to share! 

We’ll look forward to welcoming you into the world of Hozy soon.
